scope.description: Current exposed data and bounded source-census findings, classified as missing referenced page content, unresolved source-rule/field statuses, unresolved source offers, documented review-note candidates, and review queues.
limitations: Source-page censuses are discovery/review inventories, not complete row transcriptions or whole-book semantic audits.

Review-note candidates can describe scope, interpretation, or source questions without identifying a single field. They are not confirmed gaps.
Record-level source references are not asserted to support each field unless a field pointer/direct passage is identified.
Counts are valid only for the snapshot hashes below; final reports should be refreshed before publication.

Check each round. The DMG states an Intelligence 12+ minimum, but its spell-user detection table contains lower-Intelligence entries; how these interact is unresolved. For non-spell-users, base chances are fighter 2%, paladin 6%, ranger 4%, thief 6%, assassin 5%, monk 1%, bard 3%; UA adds cavalier 5% and barbarian 1%. Spell-users use the detection-of-invisibility table instead.
